proof_body:
by
  intro f w hd hb hw
  have hne : ∀ a x : ℂ, ‖a‖ < 1 → ‖x‖ < 1 → 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x ≠ 0 := by
    intro a x ha hx h
    have h1 : (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
    have h2 : ‖a‖ * ‖x‖ = 1 := by
      have := congrArg norm h1
      simpa using this
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg a, norm_nonneg x]
  have hlt : ∀ a x : ℂ, ‖a‖ < 1 → ‖x‖ < 1 → ‖(x - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x)‖ < 1 := by
    intro a x ha hx
    have hp : 0 < ‖1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hne a x ha hx)
    rw [norm_div, div_lt_one hp]
    have id : ‖1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x‖ ^ 2 - ‖x - a‖ ^ 2 = (1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2) * (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
      simp only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
      simp
      ring
    have h3 : 0 < (1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2) * (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) := mul_pos (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg a]) (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x])
    exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 hp.le (by linarith)
  have hmemw : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by simpa using hw
  set b := f w with hb'
  have hbn : ‖b‖ < 1 := hb w hmemw
  set ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun x => (x + w) / (1 + (starRingEnd ℂ) w * x) with hψ
  have hψb : ∀ x : ℂ, ‖x‖ < 1 → ‖ψ x‖ < 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have := hlt (-w) x (by simpa using hw) hx
    simpa [hψ, sub_neg_eq_add, map_neg] using this
  have hψne : ∀ x : ℂ, ‖x‖ < 1 → 1 + (starRingEnd ℂ) w * x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have := hne (-w) x (by simpa using hw) hx
    simpa [map_neg] using this
  set F : ℂ → ℂ := fun x => (f (ψ x) - b) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) b * f (ψ x)) with hF
  have hψd : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ (Metric.ball 0 1) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : ‖x‖ < 1 := by simpa using hx
    apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    exact DifferentiableAt.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (hψne x hx')
  have hψm : Set.MapsTo ψ (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) := fun x hx => by
    simpa using hψb x (by simpa using hx)
  have hfψ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x => f (ψ x)) (Metric.ball 0 1) := hd.comp hψd hψm
  have hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball 0 1) := by
    refine DifferentiableOn.div (hfψ.sub_const b) ((differentiableOn_const 1).sub (hfψ.const_mul _)) ?_
    intro x hx
    exact hne b _ hbn (hb _ (hψm hx))
  have hψ0 : ψ 0 = w := by simp [hψ]
  have hF0 : F 0 = 0 := by simp [hF, hψ0, hb']
  have hFm : Set.MapsTo F (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.closedBall (F 0) 1) := by
    intro x hx
    have := hlt b (f (ψ x)) hbn (hb _ (hψm hx))
    rw [hF0]
    simpa [hF] using this.le
  have hS := Complex.norm_deriv_le_one_of_mapsTo_ball hFd hFm one_pos
  have hψ' : HasDerivAt ψ (1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2) 0 := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℂ => x + w) 1 0 := (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).add_const w
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℂ => 1 + (starRingEnd ℂ) w * x) ((starRingEnd ℂ) w) 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).const_mul ((starRingEnd ℂ) w)).const_add 1
    have h3 := h1.div h2 (by simp)
    have e : (1 - (‖w‖ : ℂ) ^ 2) = (1 * (1 + (starRingEnd ℂ) w * 0) - (0 + w) * (starRingEnd ℂ) w) / (1 + (starRingEnd ℂ) w * 0) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Complex.conj_mul']
      simp
      ring
    rw [e]
    exact h3
  have hfw : HasDerivAt f (deriv f w) (ψ 0) := by
    rw [hψ0]
    exact (hd.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hmemw)).hasDerivAt
  have hfψ' : HasDerivAt (fun x => f (ψ x)) (deriv f w * (1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2)) 0 := hfw.comp 0 hψ'
  have hden : (1 : ℂ) - (starRingEnd ℂ) b * b ≠ 0 := hne b b hbn hbn
  have hf0 : f (ψ 0) = b := by rw [hψ0]
  have hF' : HasDerivAt F (deriv f w * (1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) b * b)) 0 := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x => f (ψ x) - b) (deriv f w * (1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2)) 0 := hfψ'.sub_const b
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun x => 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) b * f (ψ x)) (-((starRingEnd ℂ) b * (deriv f w * (1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2)))) 0 := (hfψ'.const_mul _).const_sub 1
    have h3 := h1.div h2 (by rw [hf0]; exact hden)
    have e : deriv f w * (1 - (‖w‖ : ℂ) ^ 2) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) b * b) = ((deriv f w * (1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2)) * (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) b * f (ψ 0)) - (f (ψ 0) - b) * (-((starRingEnd ℂ) b * (deriv f w * (1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2))))) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) b * f (ψ 0)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hf0, sub_self, zero_mul, sub_zero, sq (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) b * b), mul_div_mul_right _ _ hden]
    rw [e]
    exact h3
  rw [hF'.deriv] at hS
  have hnd : ‖(1 : ℂ) - (starRingEnd ℂ) b * b‖ = 1 - ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [Complex.conj_mul']
    have : (1 : ℂ) - (‖b‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((1 - ‖b‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg b])]
  have hnw : ‖(1 : ℂ) - (‖w‖ : ℂ) ^ 2‖ = 1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    have : (1 : ℂ) - (‖w‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg w])]
  rw [norm_div, norm_mul, hnd, hnw, div_le_one (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg b])] at hS
  exact hS
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 1) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖f x‖ < 1) → ‖w‖ < 1 → ‖deriv f w‖ * (1 - ‖w‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 - ‖f w‖ ^ 2
